verdict.rationale: PostHog documents its own export capabilities: scheduled batch exports, file download exports, and realtime destinations including a generic HTTP/JSON webhook. Its MIT-licensed, self-hostable open-source code also eases leaving. The evidence never names open file formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV) or shows that ALL data types (persons, replays, insights) can be exported in full. Missing for 10: documented open export formats, proof of complete export coverage across all data types, an end-to-end migration/offboarding guide, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Batch exports give you a platform to schedule data exports to supported destinations.
bulk/recurring exports must use batch exports or file download exports
send events to any HTTP endpoint, using whatever request method, URL parameter values, and JSON payload structure your application requires.
